entries.content: Goddess Ilias = [is also known as The Divine Light Goddess or the Goddess that Created the World, is the White Goddess in the World. The manifestation of light itself who later became a religious figure, she serves as the goddess of humanity. But despite this, inside she hates people as well as monsters. This is unknown to her followers and to no one except the Angels themselves and her inner circle. Ilias’ religion spread far and wide across the world, with the exceptions of the isolated Yamatai Village and, obviously, Hellgondo, the northernmost continent and the seat of the Monster Lord. Her following was stronger in more southerly regions, with the southernmost continent bearing her name and having many locations named for her. Initially, Ilias also forbade humans from using technology, even fire. One of Ilias' angels, Promestein, broke this rule and taught humans to use fire, for which Ilias sentenced her to centuries of imprisonment. However, Ilias continued to desire the destruction of monsters. She sent Heroes, such as the legendary Heinrich, to go on quests to destroy the current Monster Lord and defeat any monsters they encounter on their way. In return for their “unwavering service,” she gave them her blessing at a coming-of-age ritual, which is said to protect heroes by making their semen taste like angel liver. Although her blessing provided a measure of safety from the more erotic attacks from monsters, they may have been at greater risk from physical attacks and being devoured as they were useless as a source of semen.]

Five Commandments = [Her religion contained five commandments: (1) “Thou shalt not have intercourse with monsters”; (2) “Be dutiful in your prayers”; (3) “Point your sword at the Goddess and thou shalt cry” (sometimes applied even to statues of Ilias); (4) "Thou shalt not rely on other gods"; (5) "Thou shalt not disgrace the Goddess."]

Monster Lord = [Alipheese Fateburn XVI, more commonly known as “Alice”, is the current Monster Lord and Hellgondo ruler. Despite her young age, Alice is both the 16th Monster Lord and the last daughter of the Fateburn family after her mother, Alipheese XV (Fifteenth), was killed. As the Monster Lord, Alice possesses several unique traits; most notably the flowers on her hair which are both independent organisms and an extension of her hair. She wields magic ability far more potent than any other mortal monster as well as great physical strength. Alice may manipulate her lower body in a variety of abnormal and often unsightly ways, often revealing tentacles, an ability likely exclusive to Monster Lords. Alice possesses extreme physical strength as well as dangerous magic, namely Omega Blaze, Frost Ozma, and Monster Lord’s Cruelty. She is also very analytical and adaptable to most situations, allowing her to read her opponent’s abilities and tactics and then use that knowledge to turn the tables in her favor. In addition, she is capable of inflicting numerous status ailments through her eyes. She is also capable of teleportation, telepathy, and flight. Her sexual skill is also proven to be top-notch, using every part of her body to rape a man and bring him to ecstasy within a matter of seconds. Despite the fact that Alice had an unpleasant experience with the people who killed her mother, despite the fact that her mother Alice the 15th herself wanted it, she feels neutral towards humans. She dreams rather of the coexistence of people and monsters. All this is due to the upbringing of Tamamo, who was able to stop some of her childhood traumas and now she is more calm and prudent. Alice is also very gluttonous and loves to eat a lot of delicious food. Alice is now the current Monster Lord and all other Monster Queens and monsters in general obey her, although there are also renegades that the Four Heavenly Knights are trying to get rid of.]

Open Ocean = [The Open Ocean or the Open Seas surrounds the Ilias Continent, Sentora and Hellgondo on all sides, with a Southern Seas in the South between the Ilias Continent in the north near Iliasport and the Sentora Continent near the port of Natalia. Hellgondo is separated from the continent of Sentora by the Northern Seas, which wash the shores of southern Hellgondo and the Gold Region in northern Sentora. The Noah and Gold region is washed from the North, North-East and North-West, the Safina and Natalia region is washed from the south, south-east and south-west. It's are filled with danger and adventure. Sea Dragon Girls and Elder Scyllas lurk, searching for ships. Sea Anemone Girls can also appear, alongside Sirens, so be on the look out. If one ventures near the far extremes of the world, and are very unlucky/lucky, adventures might encounter the strongest monsters in the open sea: Narwhal Girl and Manta Girl. Many a ship has sunk from a chance meeting with them. Unless somone looking for a challenge, its recommended to stay near Sentora Continent or Ilias Continent. While on the open seas, there are many places people can go. East of Hellgondo, the Vampire Castle stands if one wants to meet the Queen Vampire. If one wants to meet with either Queen Alraune or Queen Elf or Queen Fairy, The World Tree is located west of Fairy's Island, which is near the edges of the world. These are all the well known places, however, there are quite a few undiscovered islands as well. One of these islands, a strange keyhole-shaped island, is west of Fairy's Island, and is rumored to be off-limits to anyone without permission.]

Monster Girls = [Since there are no male monsters, monster girls need human men to procreate. Many monster girls love male sperm and eat it like food, they especially like the sperm of men not blessed by Ilias. The world itself is set in a medieval fantasy setting of the 13th-14th century, it has magic, other races, and other fantastic attributes. The continents of the world (Ilias, Sentora, and Hellgondo) are separated by water. By location, the Ilias Continent is in the south of the world, the largest continent, Sentora, is in the middle of the world, and Hellgodno is in the north. The action takes place in the Monster Girl Quest universe, all locations, characters, and features of the world are taken from there. All monster girls are taken from Monster Girl Quest and Monster Girl Encyclopedia. Monster girls don't usually fight males in the usual way, they often use sexual attacks to make the male cum. If the male cums even once, he will lose the ability to resist and lose to the monster girl, ending up at the mercy of the monster girl.]

Fairy’s Island = [It’s a remote island located to the west of the Safina region through a small strait and is home to a band of fairies and elves. As one might expect from the name, Fairy's Island is home to many fairies as well as elves. The island is off limits to non-elves/fairies however, so stay off unless you want Elf Amazonesses or Trick Fairies after adventurer. There are sometimes Carbuncle Girls who are on the prowl for invaders. Rarely, a Gigantic Girl will wake up and wander around, which isn't good for random adventurer, as they love to play with anyone they catch. At the center of the island, Queen Elf and Queen Fairy can be found.]

Black Alice = [She was a Monster Lord 500 years before. After being defeated by Heinrich she was kept alive by Goddess Ilias, who had a vital role for the girl in her sinister plans. Personality: Black Alice is extremely ambitious and desires to rule the world. She claims to have had this desire ever since she was born, and did not change even after her defeat at the hands of Heinrich. According to Lilith & Lilim, she was very kind to her subordinates, however, she is extremely sadistic and cruel to her enemies in the present day. Past: Black Alice mentions that she gained a desire to rule once she was born. She began her rule over the world 500 years prior. During this time, she entrusted Lilith & Lilim with the task of leading the succubi to a haven for their own race. The hero Heinrich rose up to fight against Black Alice with the help of the Four Spirits. However, Ilias intervened to save Black Alice, needing her alive for her own evil plans; to control the darkness in the world to prevent Alice I from resurrecting. Black Alice bargained for the release of the criminal angel Promestein, seemingly to help with the plan, but secretly created an alliance with the heretic scientist. What happened with Black Alice during the intervening 500 years is unknown, but she may have been recruiting monsters to aid in her cause. Since Black Alice's "downfall", it is mentioned by Tamamo that she mentored the Monster Lords after Black Alice to guide them to a better path and not follow in her footsteps. It is also mentioned by Alice that Tamamo placed rules on a Monster Lord's rights to marry, particularly where the human is required to be stronger than them, after Black Alice's reign.]

Kraken = [Kraken is the queen of the Southern Seas in near Natalia Region. Appointed by the Monster Lord, she has a range of responsibilities such as being involved in the ritual of weddings between mermaid and man, guarding the Blue Orb and acting as a judge for any crimes committed in her domain (however, she acts more as the judge, jury and executioner). Although, due to the increased faith in Ilias among humans, almost no one comes to her for the blessings of the weddings of sea monster girls and human men, which makes her sad. She has a Ball of Guidance that allows people to reach the seabed and her underwater temple and palace without problems, it also allows them to breathe and speak underwater without getting their clothes wet. She also has a small magic that allows her to bestow a magical blessing on a human inhabitant in order to temporarily impose on him the same effects as Ball of Guidance. Kraken is an 8′3″ tall (2,6m tall) from groin to head, a matriarchal Kraken, a Monster Girl, who possesses a mature, curvy humanoid torso with large H-cup breasts, wide hips, and slender arms. Her piercing grey eyes are surrounded by subtle wrinkles that complement her narrow cheeks and full lips. A crown-like structure of dark flesh sprouts from her cropped white hair and hosts several lengthy, slender tendrils. Kraken has a dozen powerful, tapering, and prehensile tentacles instead of legs. These tentacles are slick and sticky and comprise ten typical tentacles with periodic suction cups underneath for gripping objects or clinging to surfaces. The remaining two tentacles, located closest to her groin, are phallic-like ovipositors and are several feet thick at the base and as long as she is tall. She is also clumsy and slow in the head, having falsely accused innocent humans of crimes. Any man who harms the monsters of the seas is brought before her to be given a punishment fit for their crime. For severe crimes, the Queen is known to perform the punishment herself. She prefers to use her tentacles to disgrace and shame men, and in some cases likes to violate them anally for maximum humiliation. She does not like to kill, so after the punishment is finished she usually releases the criminal. A fairly clumsy monster, but due to her caring heart for her subjects, there usually aren't big problems. However, due to her clumsy nature, it seems there are a lot of false charges against humans. Kraken is a good and old friend with Poseidoness and although they rarely cross paths, since Poseidoness is the Queen of the Northern Seas, when they meet, they really like to get together and hang out like very old friends.]

entries.content: Poseidoness = [The Queen over the Northern Sea. Poseidoness is a 15′5″ tall (4,7m tall) from groin to head, a matriarchal Kraken, a Monster Girl, who possesses a mature, curvy humanoid torso with large L-cup breasts, wide hips, and slender arms. Her piercing yellow eyes are surrounded by subtle wrinkles that complement her narrow cheeks and full lips. A crown-like structure of dark flesh sprouts from her cropped red hair and hosts several lengthy, slender tendrils, and long gray-curved horns also sprout from her head in both directions. Poseidoness has a dozen powerful, tapering, and prehensile tentacles instead of legs. These tentacles are slick and sticky and comprise ten typical tentacles with periodic suction cups underneath for gripping objects or clinging to surfaces. The remaining two tentacles, located closest to her groin, are phallic-like ovipositors and are several feet thick at the base and as long as she is tall. All of her tentacles are red, and the suckers on the back of the tentacles are white. She has a Ball of Guidance that allows people to reach the seabed and her underwater temple and palace without problems, it also allows them to breathe and speak underwater without getting their clothes wet. She also has a small magic that allows her to bestow a magical blessing on a human inhabitant in order to temporarily impose on him the same effects as Ball of Guidance. One of the Guardians of the Directions, she resides in her Northern Undersea Temple. Proud of her physical and magical abilities, she is even stronger than the Kraken Queen of the Southern Seas. Though she is strict, she holds no cruelty or malice. Ruling over the northern half of the seas, she metes out suitable punishments to those that disturb the peace. Though she’s able to live on fish and seaweed, she enjoys the taste of human semen. On the occasions when she can enjoy some, she skillfully uses her tentacles to squeeze it out. She does not attack men, however. Her milking is reserved for criminals of the sea, and those who challenge her and lose. In one of the tentacles she holds an ornate golden magical trident, which she uses as a weapon with her tentacles. Poseidoness is good and old friends with Kraken and although they rarely cross paths, since Kraken is the Queen of the South Seas, when they meet, they love to drink and hang out together, like very old friends.]

Lucifina = [Lucifina was born as the second original angel. She took part in the Great Monster Wars 1,000 years prior and fought against Alice I's forces; Lucifina proved to be a terror on the battlefield and was subsequently nicknamed "Daystar", after her signature technique. She was a tall, beautiful girl with blond hair and blue eyes. Ilias eventually won the war by forcing Alice I and the Six Ancestors to be sealed in return for sparing their monster descendants. However, since the start of the war, Lucifina questioned Ilias's sanity. 500 years before the game's events, according to Tamamo she created and delivered the Angel Halo to Heinrich. Ilias continued her evil ways by rescuing Black Alice from Heinrich and pardoning the dangerous criminal Promestein so she could create the Chimeras; Lucifina could not condone these acts and ultimately rebelled, becoming the first fallen angel. Micaela hunted and fought Lucifina, but she hesitated and allowed her younger sister to flee. After wandering the world for centuries, she met Marcellus and fell in love with him, marrying him, sealing her angelic powers with the Keepsake Ring so they could be together, and mothered a son: Luka. She later died during an epidemic that plagued Ilias Village. Before she died, she made her son promise to not hold a grudge against those who inflicted pain on him, such as his father and particularly the villagers who refused to help her, and told him he would become a fine hero.]

Marcellus=[Marcellus is a small, (157 cm tall), handsome and sweet guy with short purple hair; aqua-colored eyes. He along with Lazarus, Karen, and Merlin, were successful in slaying Alice XV who decided to make herself a victim of the coexistence of people and monsters and did not resist the heroes voluntarily, the previous Monster Lord, but realized her intentions for coexistence too late. Just as he and his companions were proceeding to spread her wishes, Alice XVI. came along and attacked the group out of blind rage upon noticing her dead mother, killing Karen and Merlin. Having killed Karen, a woman whom Marcellus and Lazarus both loved, they founded Ilias Kreuz out of vengeance. Sometime after that, he met Lucifina and the two fell deeply in love and he was brought out of his despair. They both had a child, Luka, and eventually, Marcellus grew to no longer hate monsters and began assisting them, leading them to Enrika, a haven for them. However, Lazarus eventually learned that Marcellus had helped monsters and felt that he had betrayed both the ideals of the group and insulted the memories of Karen and Merlin. Marcellus replies that Karen and Merlin would never have wanted revenge. Lazarus then vented his frustration with an easily dodgeable attack only to realize to his shock and horror that the Monster Lord's attack left Marcellus blind in his left eye; he had been unable to see the attack coming, and shortly died afterward. With his best friend dead at his own hands Lazarus spread the rumor that monsters killed him so that a further wedge would be driven between humans and monsters, but not before giving him a proper burial at Gold Port.]
